top_signals.title: Stocks Hold Near Record Highs, Crude Oil Advances: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks held near record highs with traders looking to the next big data print from the US as bets on Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes eased. Oil passed $84 a barrel as a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remained elusive.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Is China’s reflation trend running out of steam?
top_signals.summary: CPI inflation cooled more than expected China’s CPI inflation fell to 0.5% year-on-year, down from 1.0% in June, coming in lower than expectations (market: 0.8%, ING: 0.9%) and reaching a 6-month low. In month-on-month terms, CPI edged up slightly to -0.1% from -0.3%, marking the third straight month of negative territory. Core CPI fell to ...
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: The space boom has created a giant mess. Now startups want to clean it up
top_signals.summary: As Earth’s orbit gets more crowded, companies are betting that cleaning up space junk could become a lucrative new business.
